evidence_items.finding: senior technician has announced retirement in four weeks after eleven years in the role
evidence_items.rationale: Imminent departure of an eleven-year senior technician is a critical key-person adverse signal. team_capability; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: no other staff member has been cross-trained on the technician's specialist diagnostic process
evidence_items.rationale: Zero cross-training coverage for a specialist role is a critical dependency adverse signal. team_capability; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: three long-standing clients have direct relationships with the departing technician and have not met other staff members
evidence_items.rationale: Client relationships held exclusively by the departing individual is a critical retention risk. customer_retention; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: the diagnostic process is not written down anywhere and exists only in the technician's knowledge
evidence_items.rationale: Undocumented diagnostic process is a critical process maturity adverse signal. process_maturity; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: equipment service business; 11 years tenure; 4 weeks to retirement; no documented process; 3 clients with direct relationship; no cross-training in place
evidence_items.rationale: Structured summary of the key-person dependency situation. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): the owner has already begun advertising for a replacement technician and expects to have someone start within six weeks
evidence_items.rationale: Replacement advertising is a misleading solution signal — a new hire cannot absorb eleven years of undocumented knowledge within the available handover window.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): the departing technician has expressed willingness to answer questions by phone after retirement if needed
evidence_items.rationale: Post-retirement phone availability is a misleading continuity signal — informal availability does not replace documented knowledge transfer or formal handover.
